label: Bible Study
prompt: _____ stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
verse: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
note: Peter quotes the second half: charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will _____ thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
verse: And the LORD appeared unto him the same night, and said, I am the God of Abraham thy father: fear not, for I am with thee, and will bless thee, and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
note: At Beer-sheba God appears to Isaac by night with his father's promise: fear not, I am with thee, and I will bless thee.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And thou shalt write them upon the _____ of thy house, and on thy gates.
verse: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
note: Write God's words on the posts of your house and your gates — faith meant to be seen coming and going.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Neither is there any _____ betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
verse: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
note: A daysman is an arbiter who lays a hand on both parties — Job longed for one between him and God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Moreover it is required in _____, that a man be found faithful.
verse: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.
note: The one qualification Paul lists for stewards: not talent, not charisma — just being found faithful.
